subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, MAJESTY is written as TEQIZAF. How will DURABLE be written as in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• Consonants are increased by +7.
 
• Vowels are coded as their next vowel.
 
• A → E → I → O → U.
 
• *A is coded as E*
 
• *E is coded as I*
 
• *I is coded as O*
 
• *O is coded as U*
 
• *U is coded as A*

MAJESTY is written as TEQIZAF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a1cc5568f951c9b8a9c1a6cf9c524a07bf66d18092223150ea6fecee98513c5.png] 

Similarly,

'**DURABLE**' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91fea4e1a5eeac56141e5c316c3928d2282b10eaf96e32d5de9179452ade6a1c.png] 

Hence, 'DURABLE' is coded as "**KAYEISI**".
